# 1. Against a country that used to be a celestial subject of root (var:oe_cel_former_subject_of, set by W1 on_disable).
oe_cel_cb_reclaim_tianxia = {
	speed = 10
	war_goal_type = take_capital_subjugation

	create_visible = {
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		scope:target = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_variable = oe_cel_former_subject_of
			var:oe_cel_former_subject_of = root
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
	}

	create_enabled = {
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
		}
	}

	declare_enabled = {
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		scope:target = {
			NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "BASE"
			value = -50
		}
	}
}

oe_cel_cb_duhu_pacification = {
	speed = 10
